program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
             (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
             (h (+ 1 (- r2 r1))) (w (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
             (perim (+ (* 2 w) (* 2 (- h 2)))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3)
             (= (obj-size obj) perim)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) r1) (= (first p) r2)
                         (= (second p) c1) (= (second p) c2)))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define frames (filter frame? (objects (keep-only g 8) 0)))
    (define inserts
      (filter (lambda (obj) (and (not (= (obj-color obj) 8)) (filled? obj))) (objects g 0)))
    (define seeded (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([fr (in-list frames)])
                     (paint-cells out (obj-cells fr) 8)))
    (for/fold ([out seeded]) ([ins (in-list inserts)])
      (let* ((target (find-first (lambda (fr)
                                   (and (= (obj-h ins) (- (obj-h fr) 2))
                                        (= (obj-w ins) (- (obj-w fr) 2))))
                                 frames)))
        (if (eq? target #f)
            out
            (paint-cells out
                         (positions-in-rect (+ (obj-r1 target) 1) (+ (obj-c1 target) 1)
                                            (- (obj-r2 target) 1) (- (obj-c2 target) 1))
                         (obj-color ins)))))))
